title: AskGiveOp
description: This plugin requires approval from multiple OPs when making a user an OP.
body:
This plugin requires approval from multiple OPs when making a user an OP. If you are creating a new server, please grant OPs in advance before installing the plugin.

**WARNING: Before installing this plugin, please make sure that there are at least as many ops as minop in `config.yml`.**

### config.yml
- minop: Int: Minimum number of approvals required
